text.title: One day in Lauterbrunnen for 74 francs

cafe.name: Bäckerei Vincenz, on the main street
cafe.order: a croissant and a coffee before the village fills

dish.name: cheese fondue
dish.tip: Order on the tablet, take a table number; open till 8pm

spot.name: the Staubbach Falls gallery
spot.how: a ten-minute path up from the main street

items: Train from Interlaken Ost, return — CHF 15.60
Bus 141 up the valley, one way — CHF 7.80
Coffee and a croissant at Vincenz — CHF 7.60

text.mistake: At the Trümmelbach the ticket desk was running ninety minutes in August — longer than the visit itself. Go at the 9am opening, or come back late afternoon.
text.close: Send this to whoever wants the 9am path
